label: CONCLUSIVELY_10 verifiable: ConclusivelyVerifiable F s: some finite list of observation statements…
definition: `ConclusivelyVerifiable F s`: some finite list of observation statements that hold together at some world entails s.
note: Variant V1. Types the strong sense of claim AYER-LTL-PELICAN-I-18-STRONG-WEAK ('its truth could be conclusively established in experience'); reading 'established in experience' as entailment by jointly possible observation statements is the analyst's. Ayer attributes the criterion to Schlick 1931 (AYER-LTL-PELICAN-I-18-CONCLUSIVE-PROPOSED); Schlick's 1936 wording (SCHLICK-MV-351-LOGICAL-POSSIBILITY) does not say 'conclusive'.
